startup:
FailAt 21
Assign Developer: SYS:Developer
MakeDir RAM:CEFProfile
Assign PROFILE: RAM:CEFProfile
Stack 1048576
Assign AROSTCP: SYS:System/Network/AROSTCP
Run <NIL: >RAM:AROSTCP-startup.log QUIET AROSTCP:C/AROSTCP
C:WaitForPort AROSTCP
C:CEFMemorySample before-host
Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run
C:CEFHostProbe wait
If WARN
Echo MEM165-host-unavailable >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
C:CEFMemorySample host-ready
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:1 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-1-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-01
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:2 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-2-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-02
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:3 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-3-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-03
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:4 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-4-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-04
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:5 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-5-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-05
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:6 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-6-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-06
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:7 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-7-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-07
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:8 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-8-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-08
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:9 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-9-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-09
Echo MEM165-cycle-start:10 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM165-cycle-10-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-10
C:CEFHostProbe stop
Echo MEM165-stop-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
C:CEFWaitFile T:CEFHost165.done
If WARN
Echo MEM165-host-exit-timeout >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
C:CEFMemorySample host-exited
Echo MEM165-finished >DEBUG:
Wait 3600
scope: Ten sequential local-page browser lifecycles in one resident host; same A/primary profile on private FAT; no network fixture. Whole guest memory, not engine-only allocation.
